_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
U tsa raloka Klondike Solitaire. Sepheo sa hao ke ho suthisa karete tsohle ho ya kwenye matlole a thekiso.

Melao ya Mokhatlo:
- Matlole a thekiso (F1-F4): Ahlolela ho tloha Ace ho ya ho Koning ya letsopa
- Matlole a tafoleng (T1-T7): Ahlolela ho theoha ka mebala e fapaneng (kgubedu hodima kgubedu e ntsho, kgubedu e ntsho hodima kgubedu)
- Senthimithara: Tosa karete ho ya kwenye matlole a makgubedu
- Matlole a makgubedu (W): Karete ya hodimo e fumaneha bakeng sa mokhatlo

Dikgang tsa Mokhatlo:
- 'draw' - Tosa karete ho tloha senthimithareng ho ya kwenye matlole a makgubedu
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Suthisa karete kwenye matlole
  Mehlala: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. palo e ka ba le 'all', e tla leka ho suthisa karete tsohle tse kgubedu.
- 'forfeit' - Fetoha mokhatlo ka nako e kgutshwane le ho kgutshwanya sephetho sa hao sa jale
- Maina a matlole: W (matlole a makgubedu), F1-F4 (matlole a thekiso), T1-T7 (matlole a tafoleng)

U ka phetha mesebetsi e mengata ka nako e le nngwe ka ho a arola ka matlhaku:
  Mokhatlo: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Makgubedu a Koning a ka bea hodima matlole a tafoleng a sa kgubedu.
Mesebetsi e phethwa ka tatellano - ha e le hore e mong a hloleha, mesebetsi e setseng e tla hloleha.
Sebedisa 'forfeit' ha u dumela hore mokhatlo o sa kgoneha ho hloleha.

format_error.no_brackets: Sebopeho sa ketso se fosahetseng. Ketso e lokela ho ba ka har'a li-brackets.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Sebopeho sa ketso se fosahetseng. Ho haella kholomo ea ho koala ']'
format_error.empty_command: Taelo e se nang letho. Tlanya 'draw' kapa 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.move_needs_args: Kgang ya mokhatlo ya ho suthisa e hloka tse kgutshwane le sebaka sa ho ya. Tshebediso: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Nomoro e tlameha ba e kgolo kapa 'all'
format_error.count_invalid: Nomoro e sa tsejweng. Tumella nomoro kapa 'all'
format_error.unknown_command: Halofo e senyehang ka '{cmd}'. Sebelisa 'draw', 'move <source> <destination> [count]', kapa 'forfeit'
